results.plugins-subcommand-family: PASS: 'zcode plugins list|install|uninstall|enable|disable|update|validate|marketplace add|list|remove|update' all present in installed CLI
results.plugins-validate-manifest: PASS: 'plugins validate <dir>' parses .zcode-plugin/plugin.json + marketplace.json; flags only missing required userConfig (by design before configuration)
results.isolated-marketplace-add: PASS: exit 0, 'Added marketplace lam-local (1 plugins)' with USERPROFILE-redirected isolated home
results.isolated-install-enabled: PASS: exit 0, 'Installed plugin lan-agent-mesh@lam-local (0.1.0) [enabled]', cache inside isolated home
results.mcp-registration-env-vars: PASS: 'plugins list' shows mcp: plugin:lan-agent-mesh:lam-mesh once ZCODE_LAM_NODE/ZCODE_LAM_ROOT/ZCODE_LAM_CREDENTIAL_FILE are set; ${ZCODE_*} env expansion is compiled into the installed CLI's plugin template resolver
results.mcp-config-negative-without-env: PASS (re-verified live): env unset -> plugin enabled but mcp: none (fail-closed, no mesh tools); env set -> mcp: plugin:lan-agent-mesh:lam-mesh

findings: Plugin discovery is bound to the real user profile: even with ZCODE_DATA_BASE_DIR/XDG_* redirected, 'plugins list' enumerates the host's official plugins; full isolation requires USERPROFILE (and APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA) redirection. No real user plugin state was modified.
The plugins-list per-plugin counter ('commands: 1') does not reflect command registration; 'zcode commands list' is the authoritative check (4/4).

userConfig values have no non-interactive CLI setter in 0.17.0; the plugin therefore resolves its three inputs via explicit ZCODE_LAM_* environment variables (auditable, scriptable, supported by the installed resolver). Manifest keeps no secrets.
Synchronous execFile against the gateway control CLI deadlocks when the gateway runs in the same process (control HTTP server starves); async execFile required.
notRun: native ZCode session tool advertisement/call through the plugin (needs fixture-provider session harness; next step)
